newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS puts Eaton Credit Card Trust on watch list.
newsitem.headline: CBRS puts Eaton Credit Card Trust on watch list.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Thursday it placed the securities of Eaton Credit Card Trust on its credit watch list with developing implications.
Eaton Credit Card Trust ratings are A-1+ for its Receivables-Backed Short Term Notes and A++ for its Receivable-Backed Term Notes, CBRS said.

Earlier Thursday, T. Eaton Co Ltd sought an order of the Ontario Court of Justice under the Companies Creditors Arrangements Act, the rating agency said. Eaton said it had made certain arrangements with respect to the securitization funding activities undertaken by certain subsidiaries, CBRS said.
